subj: RFQ Response Hint from FindLight: Keep the Conversation Moving with the Buyer
text:
[图:FindLight — The Photonics Marketplace]
<https://www.findlight.net>











































Dear Vendor,



Many vendors delay responding because they want to provide a complete answer before contacting the buyer. However, waiting too long can cause valuable opportunities to disappear.



If you need additional information or time to prepare a quote, respond first and continue the conversation.



A good approach:



“Thank you for your inquiry. We are reviewing your requirements and would like to confirm a few technical details on our end to provide the best recommendation. We will follow up with pricing after receiving this information from our factory. Expect to hear from us in the next 24 hours.”



This is much more effective than waiting several days while clarifying details internally.



Remember: a conversation with the buyer is more valuable than a perfect response that arrives too late.



Best regards,

The FindLight Team
